items.title: Boston Scientific (BSX), What Is Behind The Latest Investor Attention?
items.summary: Boston Scientific completes multi year buyback and what it means for investors Boston Scientific (BSX) has completed a multi year share repurchase program, buying back 39,922,436 shares for about US$2.0b. The completed buyback represents 2.69% of the company’s shares. This update provides an additional data point on how Boston Scientific is allocating capital and managing its share count.
